findings.reason: Standalone original-resolution PNG shows both ket expressions as ASCII |0> and H|0> rather than mathematical kets. The Example and Verification explicitly identify the state |0\rangle and its Hadamard image H|0\rangle; the title therefore contains intended mathematical expressions omitted from math mode, rather than merely optional prose typography.
findings.action: Typeset exactly the same state and Hadamard operation using $|0\rangle$ and $H|0\rangle$ in the title.

correction: Title-only replacement of ASCII ket shorthand with inline mathematical ket notation; body and all other frontmatter preserved byte-for-byte.
